# dsh-plugins
English | 中文
Third-party plugins for DeepSeek Harness (DSH). Each directory under `packages/` is an independently
installable plugin.
The released `0.2.0` set is verified with `@deepseek-ai/dsh@0.1.0-rc.6`. Repository source targets D
SH `0.2.2-rc.1`, Cordis `4.1.0`, and Node.js `>=24.9.0`; older DSH cohorts are no longer declared su
pported by this source set. See the compatibility record for verification scope. On 2026-10-06 five
packages were retired — `dsh-agent-plugins`, `dsh-thinking-collapse`, `dsh-codex-login-dock`, `dsh-o
penai-codex-oauth`, and `dsh-composer-skill-mention` — and `dsh-worktree-workspaces` was retired on
2026-11-04. The two packages below are the maintained set. That source set is not published yet. An
additional experimental package, `dsh-codex-bridge` (read-only Codex Home compatibility), is tracked
in `packages/` but is neither published nor part of that maintained set.
## Install
The historical published release below requires Node.js 22 or later and `pnpm` on `PATH`. It is not
the current DSH `0.2.2-rc.1` source adaptation. Install only the plugins you need into the matching
`0.2.2-rc.1` source adaptation. Install only the plugins you need into the matching DSH Web profile:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Each package is independently installable. The command pins the plugin release verified with DSH `0.
1.0-rc.6`; the full scoped set was also installed and loaded in the daily DSH `0.1.0-rc.7` Web profi
le before retirement. `dsh-ui-zoom` is not published yet, so it has no install command.
The previous unscoped package names are deprecated. For the retired packages their scoped replacemen
ts are no longer maintained.
## Plugins
### @suqingsq/dsh-session-tools

model-facing session tools, plus Web `@` candidates that inject another session as sourced context.
### @suqingsq/dsh-ui-zoom
Whole-interface zoom for the Web and Desktop GUI: a Settings row with −/+ and reset, plus a durable
per-profile zoom percentage. Not published yet.
## Repository
This is a pnpm workspace. Package conventions are in AGENTS.md. The plugin index is in `packages/REA
DME.md`, and release history is tracked in CHANGELOG.md.
